For October, we will be making our own cross stitched bookmarks! All materials will be provided. Are you interested in learning new crafts? Meeting other like-minded people and making new friends? Welcome to the Crafters Society! The Crafters Society is a monthly craft club specifically aimed at adults between the ages of 18-35 who are interested in flexing their creative muscles and looking to approach life more mindfully. Each monthly session will include a themed craft project, snacks and drinks, and time to socialize and meet new people. Come join us on this creative adventure! We look forward to meeting you! Registration encouraged; limited supplies available.

item.title: Science Buzz Cafe # 579 The Neurology of Aging: Beyond the Brain! Dr. Allan L. Bernstein, Neurologist — Mon Oct 26, 6:00 PM — Hopmonk Sebastopol
item.description: The latest research on the neurology of aging beyond the brain where peripheral and autonomic systems may act as key drivers of decline. All this in ‘Plain English! Just Ask the Doc! Recent studies show neuromuscular junction (NMJ) failure contributes to sarcopenia: age-related loss of the sodium channel NaV1.4 impairs nerve-to-muscle signal transmission, correlating with weakness. This is potentially reversible—ClC-1 chloride channel inhibition restored muscle responsiveness and strength in aged models. A 2025 theory posits sympathetic-parasympathetic imbalance (excess “fight-or-flight,” reduced “rest-and-repair”) as a core driver of aging hallmarks like inflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and senescence, with vagus nerve stimulation proposed as a countermeasure. Peripheral nerves also age via reduced fiber/glial density, senescent Schwann cells that hinder regeneration, and inflammaging. item.title: Mary Collins School at Cherry Valley Presents Beetlejuice JR — Fri Oct 30, 7:00 PM — Mary Collins School at Cherry Vallet
item.description:
Something strange and unusual is coming to Mary Collins at Cherry Valley School! The school's Theater Arts Program (TAP) presents *Beetlejuice JR.*, running October 30–November 8, 2026, featuring two casts of talented young performers and a student technical crew bringing the beloved Broadway musical to life.
Under the leadership of Darby Ciampi, Lindsey Nettleton, and an experienced creative team, TAP delivers an ambitious theatrical experience that goes far beyond the stage. Students are involved in every aspect of production, from acting, singing, and choreography to lighting, sound, set construction, costumes, and props. With professional mentorship, students gain hands-on experience in the full theatrical process, developing creativity, confidence, and collaboration along the way.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Annual Dia de Muertos — Sun Nov 1, 6:00 PM — Sonoma Community Center
item.description:
November 1, 2026 at 6 PM
The Sonoma Community Center will hold its 17th annual Día de Muertos altar lighting on November 1 at 6:30 PM at the west side of the SCC Front Garden, followed by a celebration with traditional Ballet Folklórico dancers, food vendors and cultural activities on the SCC Back Patio. Whether they were family, a dear friend, a beloved companion, or someone whose life touched yours, their memory has a place here. One may also write a personal message on one of the gold paper butterflies provided at the altar, and hang it alongside the images.
